messages:
Sai Patel: quick sync — we're defining metrics for prefix + kv cache effectiveness for the Console dashboard. Need runtime + infra inputs: metric names, labels, cardinality limits, and any privacy constraints.

Anna Chen: SGTM. propose metrics: redwood_kv_cache_requests_total, redwood_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_misses_total, redwood_kv_cache_evictions_total, redwood_prefix_cache_lookups_total, redwood_prefix_cache_reuse_total, redwood_kv_cache_size_bytes (gauge), redwood_kv_cache_items (gauge). label by: model, deployment, shard, workload, seq_len_bucket, route_sampled. avoid tenant_id at high-cardinality.

Mike Rao: runtime notes — we'll emit counters from runtime with labels (model, shard, workload_type). telemetry cost: per-request labels blow up. suggest sampling for route and tenant: top_n_routes=50. I'll add a metric: redwood_cache_route_sample with route_hash label for sampled routes.

Anna Chen: cardinality rules: only allow model/deployment/workload/seq_bucket. For route-level drilldown, create a separate 'route_index' mapping table in the metrics pipeline to avoid high cardinality. We can also include 'sampled_route' boolean.

Mike Rao: instrumentation example:
```
counter('redwood_kv_cache_hits_total', labels={'model': model, 'workload': kind, 'seq_bucket': sb})
```
We'll expose via the runtime /metrics endpoint.

Julia Gomez: product ask — Console needs panels: 1) hit rate by workload (last 24h), 2) evictions per minute + top models, 3) reuse ratio by route (sampled) and 4) cost delta if cache hit-rate changes by +/-5%. Also add a rollout UX: show 'expected SLO impact' when enabling prefix cache for a model.

Kevin Liu: ops/security — don't expose raw tenant_id. Use hashed_tenant with k-anonymity and keep sampled top_tenants only in a separate dashboard. retention 90d for aggregated, 30d for per-route samples. Also ensure metrics are scrubbed of raw prompt text.

Sai Patel: PromQL drafts:
```
# hit rate by workload
100 * sum by (workload) (rate(redwood_kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum by (workload) (rate(redwood_kv_cache_requests_total[5m]))

# evictions per minute
sum(rate(redwood_kv_cache_evictions_total[5m]))

# prefix reuse ratio by workload
100 * sum by (workload) (rate(redwood_prefix_cache_reuse_total[5m])) / sum by (workload) (rate(redwood_prefix_cache_lookups_total[5m]))
```
Keep panels as heatmaps for model x seq_bucket.

Anna Chen: Also add gauge 'redwood_kv_cache_items' and 'redwood_kv_cache_utilization_percent' for capacity planning. Suggest alert: if hit_rate < 60% for 10m AND evictions > 100/min -> regression alert.

Mike Rao: runtime will add metrics by EOD Friday. we'll also emit an 'approx_unique_prefixes' gauge to help estimate cardinality.

Julia Gomez: ordering: 1) metric names & labels PR (runtime) 2) schema + doc (platform) 3) grafana draft (product) 4) rollout UX mock (product). Owner: Sai to coordinate. Meeting Wed 10am PT to finalize.

Sai Patel: assigning owners: runtime: Mike, platform: Anna, product: Julia, ops: Kevin. I'll open a threads/issue and ping you all. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: scheduled meeting created: Wed 10:00 PT — invite sent to @Mike @Anna @Julia @Kevin @Sai

Kevin Liu: quick note — we need to add GDPR review if we decide to keep any tenant samples. ping @legal when we have sampling plan.

Anna Chen: will post the initial grafana dashboard JSON in #eng-platform before the meeting.

Sai Patel: cool, thanks everyone. I'll draft the telemetry PR today and leave comments for labels/cardinality.
